prompt: The plans below show a small theatre in 2010, and the same theatre in 2012.
essay:
The maps compare the layout of the small theatre in 2010 and 2012.

Overall, the theatre underwent several structural changes during the two-year period. Although the auditorium and the main entrance remained largely unchanged throughout the period, a number of facilities were relocated, expanded, or newly constructed.

In 2010, the storage room was situated in the upper-left corner of the theatre and was adjacent to the dressing room, which was positioned beside the stage. The auditorium occupied the centre of the building and accommodated approximately 135 seats. To the right of the main entrance was a café, while the administration office and the ticket office were located in the bottom-left corner.

By 2012, the storage room had been relocated to the upper-right corner, whereas the dressing room occupied its former position. A corridor was constructed between these two facilities, and shower facilities were added next to the dressing room. Although the stage retained its original position, it was expanded. In addition, the ticket office was relocated to the former site of the café, while a restaurant was constructed in the bottom-left corner. Consequently, the administration office was moved above the restaurant. Despite these modifications, the auditorium and the main entrance remained unchanged.
